name: LF-inferred-property-local
source:
<?php
namespace Demo;
class Repository {}
$note="𐐀";
class Service {
    /**
    
    private $repository;
    public function __construct() { $this->repository = new Repository(); }
    public function repository() { return $this->repository; }
}
echo get_class((new Service)->repository()) === Repository::class ? 99 : 7;
